text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since I became<n>Sasami
Anshinzawa's acupuncture test<n>dummy.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
After heading out with her, I would train<n>to
become more Umamusume-like and<n>receive
acupuncture treatment. One<n>such day...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good, good! ♪ Your body's shaping up<n>just the
way I like! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now you should be able to participate<n>on that
legendary stage that everyone<n>dreams of—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: The Needle Series!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: What?! You've never heard of it?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The Needle Series is the highlight of the<n>
acupuncture world, where<n>
acupuncture-augmented humans are<n>pitted
against each other in races!
choice_data_list: And... you want me to participate in it?
And... you want me to participate in it?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Precisely! ♪ We're an unstoppable duo<n>together,
with you as the runner and me<n>as the trainer! Our
victory is practically<n>guaranteed!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Why, what's this? You don't seem all<n>that
excited!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen, once you experience running in a<n>race
yourself, you'll be able to apply<n>what you learn in
your trainee's training<n>sessions!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Посмотритеing a race and running one are<n>two
completely different things! Haven't<n>you realized
this from your training up<n>till now? You must
have!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want <chrname><n>to
improve? Don't you want to help her<n>achieve her
dreams?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, you have no choice but to<n>enter this
competition! Then you'll have<n>no worries in the
world! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! All right, it's decided!<n>Now that
that's finalized, let's go get<n>you signed up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If you manage to win it all, people will<n>come to
recognize my skills too, so it'll<n>be two birds with one
stone! ♪

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
And that's how my partnership with<n>Sasami
Anshinzawa begins!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, our goal is to dominate the<n>Needle
Series, and to do that, we'll have<n>to Выиграйте в
Sasabari Sho! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, you can't enter it right<n>away—you'll
need to accumulate plenty<n>of racing experience
to qualify!
choice_data_list: I-I wasn't expecting this series to be so legit...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's set our sights on winning<n>the
Bamboo Stakes! ♪ Aaand to do<n>that...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You're going to have to undergo more<n>advanced
training. ♪ I'd say we'll need<n>to ramp training up
to level five!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Do a volleyball dive!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next up, some rapid doggy paddling!<n>Wow,
you're crazy fast! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Karate chop that tile! Yaaah! No worries!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No worries! No worries! Good, keep<n>pulling that
tire in time with the<n>chant! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, you will face me in shogi! Do you<n>have
what it takes to—no way, did you<n>just put me in
check already?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, great job toda—whoa! You're<n>looking pretty
burnt-out!
choice_data_list: My body can't handle any more of this...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Don't worry, you can count on<n>your dear
trainer to provide an extra<n>special treatment as a
reward for your<n>hard work! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: To the infirmary! Let's go, go, go!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, this is the Rest in Peace chakra,<n>and when I
poke it, all your fatigue will<n>be washed away! ♪
choice_data_list: That's not a very reassuring name...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh come on, don't be like that! Thetexts I read definitely described it thatway!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Enough chitchat! Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
When I come to my senses, I find myself<n>standing
in an unfamiliar place. The last<n>thing I remember,
I was receiving<n>acupuncture treatment, but...
Trainer... Trainer, canst thou hear me?

I am the god of acupuncture... Ye who<n>seeketh
the zenith of the Needle Series,<n>I hereby bestow
upon thee mine<n>blessings...

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
O Trainer, dost thou desireth the power<n>to attain
glory?

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
Nay, thou needn't answer, for I know<n>thou cravest
it so. Very well, allow me to<n>fulfill thy desire!

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text: Annnd poketh!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
An almighty feeling flows throughout my<n>body. So
this is the power bestowed by<n>the gods!
choice_data_list: O kindly god, thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: God of Acupuncture(?)
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Whilst thou art at it, please<n>look after
that fool of an acupuncturist<n>as well...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake. I bet you feel<n>nice and
refreshed, don't you? Looks<n>like it was a great
success!

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Whatever that was, my body is feeling<n>better
than ever. All traces of my fatigue<n>seem to have
vanished.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
So this is the power bestowed by the<n>gods? It's
not quite as miraculous as I<n>thought it'd be.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I feel as though my vitality is<n>being
steadily drained from my body!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wha—? That's strange... There's no way<n>that I,
divine acupuncturist as I am,<n>would ever slip up
during treatment!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Eh, whatever! Thank you for your<n>patronage, and
come again! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're finally awake. You were<n>tossing and
turning in your sleep a lot.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Anyways, I'm heading on home! See you!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I missed that chakra point by a<n>millimeter, but
that probably didn't<n>cause any lasting issues,
right?! Nah,<n>definitely not!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I knew it all along—acupuncture is the<n>solution to
everything! ♪ No worries! ☆

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
I don't know whether to blame the<n>botched
acupuncture or the weird<n>dream, but either way...
My fatigue<n>doesn't improve in the slightest.
